Subject: SIG: artifact deadline Apr 23 - follow-up

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for running through the SIG a week ago. Our procurement/legal team is trying to close the file and they set a hard artifact delivery window: can you provide the outstanding artifacts by end-of-day Apr 23 PT?

Specifically the items we still need (per your SIG export):
- SOC 2 Type II report (covering 2026) or URL to hosted evidence
- KV key rotation/runbook for customer-managed keys (Control CR-7)
- Signed data retention schedule and deletion playbook (summary PDF)

If you can’t hit Apr 23 we need a clear micro-SLA (date/time) and confirmation that you’ll deliver a single zip of artifacts + a mapping sheet that ties each file to the SIG control IDs.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — we’re aiming to complete vendor review by Monday EOB.

Best,
Tom

Sr. Security Programs Manager
Carbon Analytics

Team — forwarding Carbon’s ask. They want everything by Apr 23 EOD PT. I mapped what we already have and what’s missing; see attached mapping. Please read below and reply with exact deliverable you own + ETA.

Quick plan proposal:
- Monica: SOC2 PDF (if finalized) + evidence pointer URLs -> drop in Drive and flag in mapping sheet
- Rishi: KV rotation runbook & any audit logs for rotations -> redline and send as PDF
- Aditya: sign-off and if we need to request a 24h breathing room, coordinate with Tom (I don’t want to ask unless strictly necessary)

I’ve attached redwood_sig_artifact_map.xlsx with an initial mapping (column: control_id, artifact_name, owner, status). If you update, add a short note column with the earliest timestamp you can deliver.

Thanks — Neha

—Monica

If we can push Carbon by 24 hours (new target Apr 24 11:00 PT) we can produce a single zip that contains everything plus the mapping sheet. If not, I can deliver the SOC PDF + runbook (scrubbed partial logs) by Apr 23 17:00 PT and follow up with masked logs on Apr 24 morning.

If you prefer to deliver a partial bundle by Apr 23 17:00 PT (SOC PDF + runbook without full logs), we’ll accept that as long as we have the promised follow-up on Apr 24 morning. Either way, we’d like the final sign-off email from your procurement/commercial owner stating this is the final artifact bundle for vendor review.
